```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```

Load swimming data and calculate percent motile
```{r}
data <- read.csv("data/swimming/20231212_swimming.csv")

data$percent.motile <- (data$swimming / (data$swimming + data$still)) * 100
data$Treatment <- as.factor(data$Treatment)

# Assumption checks: normality per group and equal variances
data |> group_by(Treatment) |>
  summarise(shapiro_W = shapiro.test(log10(percent.motile))$statistic,
            shapiro_p = shapiro.test(log10(percent.motile))$p.value)
var.test(log10(percent.motile) ~ Treatment, data = data)

# Ambient group fails normality (W = 0.66, p = 0.004); reporting Wilcoxon rank-sum
# Both tests agree: t-test p = 0.040, Wilcoxon p = 0.032
wilcox.test(percent.motile ~ Treatment, data = data)

```

Load and separate size and stage data
```{r}
size  <- read.csv("data/size_stage/20231212_size.csv")
stage <- read.csv("data/size_stage/20231212_stage.csv")

# Separate embryo and larval size measurements
embryo_size <- size |> filter(stage == "Egg")
larval_size  <- size |> filter(stage == "Larvae")
```

Calculate embryo sphere volume and stage proportions at 08:35 first sampling
```{r}
# Sphere volume from mean of two diameters (µm), converted to mm³
embryo_size <- embryo_size |>
  mutate(
    mean_diam  = (diameter1 + diameter2) / 2,
    volume     = (4/3) * pi * (mean_diam / 2)^3,
    volume_mm3 = volume / 1e9
  )

# Stage proportions pooled across all tubes
stage_prop <- stage |>
  summarise(across(c(egg, cell2, cell4, cell8), sum)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "stage", values_to = "count") |>
  mutate(
    stage      = factor(stage, levels = c("egg", "cell2", "cell4", "cell8"),
                        labels = c("Egg", "2-cell", "4-cell", "8-cell")),
    proportion = count / sum(count)
  )

# Embryo volume boxplot
p1 <- ggplot(embryo_size, aes(x = "Ambient", y = volume_mm3)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.4, color = "blue") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6, color = "blue") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression("Embryo Volume (mm"^3*")")) +
  theme_classic()

# Label midpoints: ggplot stacks in reverse factor order (last level at bottom)
stage_prop_pos <- stage_prop |>
  arrange(desc(stage)) |>
  mutate(
    x          = 1,
    cumulative = cumsum(proportion),
    midpoint   = cumulative - proportion / 2
  )

# Stage proportion stacked bar with side labels
p2 <- ggplot(stage_prop_pos, aes(x = x, y = proportion, fill = stage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.25, y = midpoint, label = stage), hjust = 0, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1, labels = "Ambient", limits = c(0.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p1 | p2
```

Calculate larval oblate spheroid volume and t-test after development at 28°C and 31°C
```{r}
# Oblate spheroid volume: V = (4/3) * pi * a^2 * c
# a = length semi-axis (diameter1 / 2), c = width semi-axis (diameter2 / 2)
larval_size <- larval_size |>
  mutate(
    volume     = (4/3) * pi * (diameter1 / 2)^2 * (diameter2 / 2),
    volume_mm3 = volume / 1e9
  )

# Assumption checks: normality per group on raw and log-transformed volume
larval_size |> group_by(treatment) |>
  summarise(shapiro_W_raw = shapiro.test(volume_mm3)$statistic,
            shapiro_p_raw = shapiro.test(volume_mm3)$p.value,
            shapiro_W_log = shapiro.test(log(volume_mm3))$statistic,
            shapiro_p_log = shapiro.test(log(volume_mm3))$p.value)

# Log transformation resolves non-normality in High group (p: 0.008 → 0.802)
# Equal variances not required for Welch t-test
# Reporting Welch t-test on log-transformed volume
t.test(log(volume_mm3) ~ treatment, data = larval_size)


```

Multi-panel figure: A) embryo size and stage proportions, B) percent motile, C) larval volume
```{r}
p_motile <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Treatment, y = percent.motile, color = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Ambient" = "blue", "High" = "red")) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Motile Embryos (%)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_volume <- ggplot(larval_size, aes(x = treatment, y = volume_mm3, color = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Ambient" = "blue", "High" = "red")) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = expression("Larval Volume (mm"^3*")")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

fig1 <- (p1 + labs(tag = "A") | p2 + labs(tag = "B") | p_motile + labs(tag = "C") | p_volume + labs(tag = "D")) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave("figures/Figure2_embryo_larval_phenotypes.pdf", fig1, width = 12, height = 4)
ggsave("figures/Figure2_embryo_larval_phenotypes.png", fig1, width = 12, height = 4)
fig1
```
